newsitem.title: USA: Weather in Brazil coffee areas turning milder - WSC.
newsitem.headline: Weather in Brazil coffee areas turning milder - WSC.

text.p: The weather in Brazil's coffee areas will turn milder, with no damaging cold expected through the weekend, independent forecaster Weather Services Corp said on Thursday.
There will be a few isolated showers in this period, with temperatures near to above normal levels. Low temperatures will be mostly in the 50s F.
WSC said the outlook was for partly to variably cloudy weather from Saturday to Monday, with a daily chance of a few light showers and temperatures averaging near to above normal.

Conditions for the trees are generally favourable, with last week's rains improving soil moisture conditions prior to the normal winter dry season. Harvest weather is favourable and there is no damaging cold weather expected through early next week.
East-central Brazil was mostly dry on Wednesday, with highs of 72-90 and lows of 43-61.
